item.title: Build Your Own DDNS Platform: Self-Hosted Dynamic DNS with PowerDNS, Node.js, and React
item.description: If you run servers at home — a homelab, a NAS, a local Kubernetes cluster — you have probably hit the same wall: your ISP gives you a dynamic IP address that changes without warning. Commercial DDNS services like DynDNS or No-IP solve this, but they come with account limits, paywalls, and you surrender full control of your data. I wanted something I own end-to-end, so I built ddns.devops-monk.com — a fully self-hosted Dynamic DNS platform.
